encoding.transcriptContext: canonical JSON of {v: "veilops-range-v2", ...publicInputs}; text fields must match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}
encoding.bitChallenge: T = utf8("VEILOPS/range/v2/bit") || ctxHash || u32be(index) || C_i || A_0 || A_1; e = LE( SHA-256(0x00||T) || SHA-256(0x01||T) ) mod L
encoding.bitCheck: A_0 = s0*H - c0*C_i, A_1 = s1*H - c1*(C_i - G); accept iff c0 + c1 = e (mod L); then sum(2^i * C_i) = C (lower) and = maxAmount*G - C (upper)
encoding.proof: u8 version (2) || u8 n || n lower bits || n upper bits; bit = C_i(32) || c0 || c1 || s0 || s1 (32-byte little-endian scalars, must be < L)
encoding.proofId: "prf_" + first 20 hex chars of SHA-256(proof bytes)

cases.description: invalid: one bit flipped in s0 of lower bit 0
invalid: c1 of upper bit 5 changed
invalid: lower and upper halves swapped
invalid: non-canonical scalar (s1 of lower bit 2 set to L)
invalid: bit commitment of lower bit 1 is not a valid point
